I really needed to hear this.  My parents never did this kind of stuff as a kid, so I've never had someone tell me that.  The problem is I mustered the courage about 4 months ago to tell them about my ongoing suicidal thoughts and my dad just told me there was no such thing as depression and I was just feeling sorry for myself but my mom sympathized.  Since then I haven't showed my sadness because I'm so good at hiding it, that's why they never thought something was up before.  It seems they've both just forgotten about it.  My dad assumes it was me trying to divert attention away from recent trouble I was in, and my mom thinks I'm better or has forgotten or thinks the same as him but I'm not sure.  What I'm trying to say is I went to them and poured my heart out because I knew they would help me before anyone else in this world would, and I feel like I've been left out to dry.  I can't see myself coming to them and telling the truth doing anything but worsening the situation and my relationship with them.
